thread:
Elise: quick note — billing numbers are drifting vs sampled traces again. suspect root cause: we do late enrichment that reassigns cost cohorts, but sampling was already applied at ingress.
Victor: yeah that mismatch will bias cohort-level cost. do we have any stable join key today?
Elise: no stable key beyond trace_id. enrichment derives cohort from prompt tokens + model routing, so trace_id sampling doesn't reflect post-enrich cohorts.
Mina: TL;DR: introduce an ingress 'sample_token' that we carry and use as the canonical join key. enrich emits (sample_token -> cohort) mapping for billing to consume.
Victor: OK. we need to decide header format, versioning semantics, and where to store mappings (fast lookups vs durable archive).
Elise: header: `X-Sample-Token: v1:<short-base62>`. keep token <=12 chars. version prefix makes future changes manageable.
Mina: storage: enrich writes to compacted kafka keyed by (version, token) -> cohort. small consumer populates a redis cluster for low-latency billing lookups with TTL = billing_lookback + safety. also append to analytics store for backfill.
Victor: TTL sizing is critical — billing queries sometimes look back 10 days. we should set default TTL 14d and revisit if cost is too high.
Elise: collision detection: enrich should emit metric `sample_token_conflict` when an existing token maps to a different cohort. first-writer-wins is acceptable but conflicts must be monitored.
Mina: header integrity: consider signing tokens (HMAC key_versioned) so enrich can verify provenance. unsigned tokens marked `unverified=true` in mapping and treated lower-confidence.
Victor: fallback behavior: if token missing or redis miss, billing falls back to cohort heuristics and marks `cohort_estimated=true`. backfill job can replay raw payloads to rebuild mappings and tag `reconstructed=true`.
Elise: rollout plan: 1) spec header + signing; 2) spike: enrich writes mapping -> kafka; 3) consumer -> redis + CH; 4) SDKs/edge add token (initially derive from trace_id for compatibility); 5) switch to random tokens + signing; 6) enable billing lookup and monitor deltas.
Mina: tests: header lost, version mismatch, token collision, redis eviction during query window, and key rotation for signing. include synthetic traffic to validate memory/QPS for redis.
Victor: operational ops: add a debug endpoint to look up token -> cohort (auth gated) and an alert on `conflict_rate > 0.01%`.
Elise: can someone draft RFC with rollout steps and estimated infra cost (redis memory + kafka throughput)? I'll link the RFC to a ticket.
infra-bot: created ticket INF-14777: "ingress sample_token + mapping pipeline for stable cost attribution" -> https://go/internal/INF-14777
Mina: I'll take the spike and run entropy tests comparing trace-derived tokens vs random. will report back with memory/QPS estimates.
Victor: thanks. happy to help with the billing pipeline changes once the mapping read API is specified.
Elise: great—target RFC early next week. :white_check_mark:
